property_summary: For any owner/collateral/debt/factory addresses encoded as immutable args (owner at 0x0, collateral at 0x14, debt at 0x28, factory at 0x3c), a Cooler clone must return from collateral() exactly the collateral token address it was created with; the mutant reads offset 0x0 instead, so it returns the owner and diverges whenever owner != collateral.
change_summary: Read the immutable arg at offset 0x0 (the owner) instead of 0x14, so collateral() returns the owner address.
